turns.question: what is Article 11?
turns.answer:
Article 11 is the part of the Illinois Pension Code that governs the City of Chicago municipal employees’ retirement fund.

It covers matters such as:
- how your service is counted for annuity purposes;
- employee and City contributions;
- limits on age and service annuities; and
- automatic increases after retirement. [40 ILCS 5/11-215] [40 ILCS 5/11-170] [40 ILCS 5/11-149] [40 ILCS 5/11-134.1]

Your record places you in Article 11. The specific pension rules that apply to you can also depend on your tier, retirement date, age, service, and the type of benefit involved. The sections in front of me do not provide the complete eligibility and benefit formula needed to determine your pension amount.
